title: 'We can feel the RN wave coming': A traditional stronghold of French conservatives shifts right

title: Ancient wall discovered in Paris, possibly confirming site of city's original settlement
subhed: The stone-and-wood wall, about 20 meters long, was unearthed in the heart of Paris, the Ministry of Culture said. It may be a fragment of the rampart of Lutetia, built by the Gallic Parisii tribe.
